subject.title: fix(calendar): display event-local times in event timezone

question: Should calendar event output keep `timezone` as the containing/display calendar timezone while adding event-local display, or intentionally redefine `timezone` to mean the event timezone?
rationale: The PR makes a compatibility-sensitive JSON/plain output contract change, and source inspection alone cannot decide whether maintainers want that public schema change or a narrower display-only fix.

options.title: Preserve current metadata contract
options.body: Keep `timezone` for the containing/display calendar timezone, keep `eventTimezone` when event metadata differs, and adjust local fields without hiding the distinction.

options.title: Redefine output around event timezone
options.body: Accept the schema change only with maintainer approval, docs updates, migration notes, and coverage for existing calendar-timezone consumers.

options.title: Pause until a narrower design lands
options.body: Hold this PR until the calendar output contract and endpoint-specific timezone behavior are specified clearly enough to review mechanically.

recommendation.title: Preserve current metadata contract
recommendation.body: Keep `timezone` for the containing/display calendar timezone, keep `eventTimezone` when event metadata differs, and adjust local fields without hiding the distinction.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent calendar-local display fixes and follow-up issue handling point to this area ownership.
